name: hcapp_deleteChatMessage
description: Deletes one chat message — run, kennel or room — for everyone (E9.F1.S13/S14, 2026-09-29): the caller's own, or anyone's if they moderate that thread (moderateChat in the kennel; SuperAdmin for rooms). The rule lives in HC6.nonApi_deleteChatMessage; this SP authenticates and replies. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 123, standard token — the server decides who may remove the message from the token's user, so binding the token to the message id would add a failure mode without removing a risk). Soft delete (EventMessage.Removed = 1); idempotent — already gone reads as 1 from the helper or 1981 'not found'.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The message to delete (HC.EventMessage.id). Default NULL → 1980 'Missing fields' (errorType 2).

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth 1223 / 1323 / 1223 signed out) returns the error detail ALONE — no envelope row before it.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Success envelope, or the compact failure envelope followed by the detail at index 1.

columns.name: errorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success. On failure this column is absent: the row is { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } — 1980 missing id (2), 1981 not found (3), 1982 not allowed (3), 1983 unhandled (5).

rowsets.description: After a { success = 0 } envelope: 1980, 1981, 1982 (errorId from nonApi_deleteChatMessage) or 1983.

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.nonApi_deleteChatMessage (@userId, @messageId, caller name, HcVersion) — sets HC.EventMessage.Removed = 1 and updatedAt; writes HC.ErrorLog itself on a refusal and returns the errorId.
trgEventMessageActivityCount refreshes the run card's chat count.
LOG.GeneralLog line with the removed text when a moderator removes someone else's message.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1980 (pre-flight) and in the CATCH.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
